description: This file contains functions for generating report conditions, validating filters, retrieving data, and handling period ranges for a reporting module in ERPNext, specifically related to trends and analytics.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report column conditions based on filters and transaction type.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates mandatory filters and fiscal year existence.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on filters and conditions, handling different grouping and transaction types.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges
methods.description: Calculates date ranges for periods like Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly within a fiscal year.

methods.name: get_period_month_ranges
methods.description: Returns list of months within each period range.

methods.name: based_wise_columns_query
methods.description: Returns column details and SQL select parts based on 'based_on' filter.

methods.name: group_wise_column
methods.description: Returns grouping column SQL snippet if 'group_by' filter is provided.
